## Silo remote playback

With **Enable throughout Windows** on in **Settings → Remote**, use Left and Right to rewind or fast-forward while the player controls are hidden or the timeline has focus. Each press uses the skip interval configured in your Silo profile.

- On the visible button row, use the arrows and OK to choose playback controls, audio, subtitles or another episode.
- On the timeline, OK returns focus to Play/Pause.
- Dedicated Previous and Next buttons seek within the current episode. Play/Pause controls that video and Stop leaves the player.

## Windows x64

Install the Windows x64 setup below or use **Settings → Updates → Check for updates**. The experimental update is signed. The installer checksum is included in SHA256SUMS.txt.

Testing covered saved remote mappings and a local video with Silo’s PlayerControls and SeekBar components. Chrome reached all 14 transport controls in the desktop layout and all 10 in the compact layout. Audio, subtitle and chapter selection were also exercised. Physical Skip 1s / Flirc input on a Windows PC still needs a hands-on check.
